extracted.intended_audience: researchers in archaeology, preprint authors, reviewers, and editors using Sciety / Peer Community in Archaeology
extracted.subtask_description: Describes the Peer Community in Archaeology preprint peer‑review and recommendation practice as presented on Sciety, using PReF (preprint review features) descriptors to report key elements of each group's evaluation activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission / scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Free and transparent preprint peer-review and recommendation by and for researchers in Archaeology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of PReF descriptors
rubrics_metrics.description: Sciety uses the PReF (preprint review features) descriptors to describe key elements of each Group's evaluation activities, helping readers to interpret and compare their evaluations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review requested by
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates who initiates the request for a review (in this case, the authors of the preprint).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer selected by
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies who selects/picks the reviewer(s) for the evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public interaction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates whether there is public interaction (e.g., open commenting or discussion) as part of the review process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of author response
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that authors may include a response to reviews/comments as part of the process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The group's recommendation decision is presented as a binary outcome (e.g., recommended / not recommended).

rubrics_metrics.name: Review coverage
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews cover the entire manuscript rather than only portions (e.g., not just an abstract or selected sections).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer identity known to
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that reviewer identities are known to the editor or the service (i.e., not necessarily publicly revealed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Competing interests
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Competing interests are checked as part of the review process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content license
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors of comments, reviews and recommendations retain copyright© under CC BY.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the license under which reviews/recommendations/comments are published (Creative Commons Attribution).
